top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5607(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Booster seats were not being utilized for children with a height of 4 feet, 8 inches or less as required by standards.

top_violation_types.title: Safety restraint devices for child used when vehicle is on and during all time vehicle in motion (26 TAC §746.5607(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained, students are not wearing the required seatbelts while the bus is in motion.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.3427)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 6 active ant beds were present on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.
